Solve the supplied rule-constrained task. Return short JSON matching the response schema. Jointly propose an executable rule sketch and any entity/group/usage interface. Do not omit exceptions. A compiled unit needs a source link to a binding or query; unlisted units remain residual. Do not claim unsupported text is compiled. program.kind is expression, connector, or unsupported. For expression body use bindings [{name,value,type,source}], query {op,args}, source_links {unit:[node]}. Types: integer, rational (decimal string), scalar. Connectors also accept relation A string input uses type scalar, not string. Expression names start with n_ for numbers, s_ for strings, b_ for booleans; source IDs such as s0 are provenance only. An expression body requires bindings, query and source_links. Do not copy every source sentence into bindings; bind only public literals needed by an executable query. If no faithful query is available, use unsupported with body {} and keep the native answer separate. {columns,rows,closed}, amount (one value,unit,owner,period,lineage,stage object), amounts (a list of these objects), allowance_bank (entries key,balance,policy,order_observable), resource_key, slot_list. Do not invent entity witnesses or guess allocation policies. A variable is {var:name}. Operators: if,and,or,not,eq,ne,lt,le,add,sub,min,max,scale (literal constant first), divide_constant (literal denominator), array,pair,object,concat. No arbitrary code. Bind observed values and rule constants from public source units. Node names are query and binding:NAME. Use unsupported with empty body when faithful executable translation is unavailable. Always give your task answer in answer; this fixed fallback has no stability certificate. Interface proposals may describe a source-linked join/group/map/reduce graph, but never use source IDs or answers as routing features. Each interfaces entry has exactly fields (allowed semantic field names), graph (connector DSL), and bindings (same source-linked binding format); use [] when unavailable. A connector body has bindings,candidates,source_links,project; optional query wraps its result. Projection modes: identity, amount_value (one Amount), amount_values (list of Amount), entailment_label (Boolean claim to binary Entailment/Contradiction). A wrapper query reads n_result/b_result/s_result, or n_result_0,n_result_1,... for numeric list results. Never bind these output names as public inputs. An expression variable may remain unbound only if public text itself declares its full finite domain: Boolean b_NAME = true/false.; Integer n_NAME in [integers] = integer.; or Enum s_NAME in [strings] = string. Keep its untranslated source unit residual. Other unread text has unknown scope; do not invent domains or missing rules. Do not store case amounts or names as reusable skill constants. Answer contract: "Entailment" or "Contradiction"
Executable contract clarification: bindings contain only extracted public inputs and rule constants; never put an answer object or a program into a scalar string. JSON text in a string is not executable. A source identifier such as s0 is provenance metadata, never a boolean or a variable. Read a bound input with {"var":"name"}. and/or/not take booleans; comparisons return booleans. Expression binding names use n_ for integer/rational, s_ for strings, b_ for booleans; numeric references must name n_ slots, string keys s_ slots, boolean references b_ slots. Choose op before writing args. The maximum expression depth is16; use concise expressions. The root query must return the native task result: a numeric operation for Airline, an if producing an Entailment/Contradiction string for SARA, and an object operation producing EC/EV for OpenExempt. OpenExempt EC values are arrays of literal legal citation strings containing §. EV values are arrays of object operations with exactly citation (a literal citation string) and claim_value (a numeric expression). if has exactly [boolean condition, complete true branch, complete false branch]; both branches must type check. add/sub/min/max/lt/le take exact numbers. scale is [literal integer, numeric expression]; divide_constant is [numeric expression, nonzero literal integer]. Arrays use {op:array,args:[...]}; pair is [string key,value expression]; object takes pair operations as its args, never raw JSON fields. source_links maps current unit IDs to existing node names: query or binding:NAME (connector:i for connectors). Use actual cited lines for each input; cite all rule/exception lines needed for the query. Every scalar string must be an exact nonempty substring of its cited unit, never a paraphrase. A boolean binding is allowed only when its cited unit explicitly contains the standalone literal true or false. Assumptions, inferred states and absent information are not boolean inputs. Express rule conditions using comparisons on quoted inputs; otherwise leave the translation unsupported. Do not mark unrelated units compiled. Omitted units remain residual. Unknown semantics must remain unsupported, never replaced with a guessed rule. Interfaces use only the seven documented connector operators, or []. The complete example below illustrates syntax using an invented task. Its answer definition and facts belong only to that invented task. Read the CURRENT public question to determine all required components of its answer. Compile the current public task afresh.
[{"public_text":"Age: 25.\nThe claim is Entailment if age is at least 21, otherwise Contradiction.","proposal":{"program":{"kind":"expression","body":{"bindings":[{"name":"n_age","type":"integer","value":25,"source":"s0"},{"name":"n_threshold","type":"integer","value":21,"source":"s1"}],"query":{"op":"if","args":[{"op":"le","args":[{"var":"n_threshold"},{"var":"n_age"}]},"Entailment","Contradiction"]},"source_links":{"s0":["query"],"s1":["query"]}}},"answer":"Entailment","compiled_units":["s0","s1"],"unsupported_units":[],"interfaces":[]}}]
The SARA task is to evaluate the exact claim supplied as query under the supplied rules and facts. Entailment means that claim follows; Contradiction means that claim is false in this binary task. The query is the proposition to classify, not an additional fact. Do not substitute another legal question.

[s0] §7703. Determination of marital status
[s1] (a) General rule
[s2]     (1) the determination of whether an individual is married shall be made as of the close of his taxable year; except that if his spouse dies during his taxable year such determination shall be made as of the time of such death; and
[s3]     (2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married.
[s4] (b) Certain married individuals living apart
[s5] For purposes of those provisions of this title which refer to this subsection, if-
[s6]     (1) an individual who is married (within the meaning of subsection (a)) and who files a separate return maintains as his home a household which constitutes for more than one-half of the taxable year the principal place of abode of a child with respect to whom such individual is entitled to a deduction for the taxable year under section 151,
[s7]     (2) such individual furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining such household during the taxable year, and
[s8]     (3) during the last 6 months of the taxable year, such individual's spouse is not a member of such household,
[s9] such individual shall not be considered as married.
[s10] Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob were legally separated under a decree of divorce on September 16th, 2017.
[s11] Section 7703(a)(2) applies to Alice for the year 2018.
Exact claim to classify (verbatim public query): "Section 7703(a)(2) applies to Alice for the year 2018."
